Gourd Ghoul.does: A hulking pumpkin-skinned brute roars, swings both fists at you, then screams.
Gourd Ghoul.credit: Inspired by: pumpkin-headed lunging stalkers. Realistic character model from Mixamo (Adobe).

Grave Grabber.does: Lies flat on his grave, drags himself to his feet, screams, then lunges in to bite.
Grave Grabber.credit: Inspired by: zombie "groundbreaker" props. Realistic character model from Mixamo (Adobe).

Stiltz.does: A 10-foot clown in a black suit laughs at you, lunges with both arms, shrieks, then breaks into a dance.
Stiltz.credit: Inspired by: towering clowns. Realistic character model from Mixamo (Adobe).

Moon Howler.does: A clawed, skinless ghoul roars, screeches at the ceiling, then slashes at you with both claws.
Moon Howler.credit: Inspired by: towering werewolves and ghouls. Realistic character model from Mixamo (Adobe).
